item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Ready for today? Here is your weather report for Friday, September 18. It's Friday. The weekend is very nearly here! Shanghai is going to be cloudy today. The high will be 32 degrees, and the low will be 24 degrees. It's going to be a real scorcher. Rain is about 31 percent likely today. The sun goes down at 5:56 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Stay cool, drink plenty of water, and find some shade! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be damp with light drizzle, reaching 31 degrees. This week is all about school bags and desks. What is your favourite part? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
